newSyntheticAssertionsProposed: Three sequential tenants/operator on one source all retain independent claims/trades/lots after the first confirmation.
Actual close-all payload obeys migration 061 exit identity and keeps acquisition mode, tenant and exact quantity; no paper completion of a live lot.
No-lot master is skipped, and pending source/lot exits cannot over-reserve that master while aggregate balance belongs to others.
Stop-loss 10 of wallet 100 carries canonical lot identity/reservation and exact quantity through every venue; missing decimals refuse.
Canonical Jito swat-prefixed IDs settle through correct execution lookup with exact receipts/fees; DB failure after observation is durably retried.
Concurrent submit/store-failure/lost-response paths retain pre-POST signed identity and unknown reservations without duplicate build/send.
Valid extra transfer/approval/ALT/recipient/minimum-output substitution refuses before signature even with passing simulation.
Atomic daily/capacity liabilities include pending/unknown/unpriced commitments and separate paper/live.
Two process-like config contexts and final-sign barriers enforce emergency epoch and current user/subscription/tolerance constraints.
Same-user full-resource envelope binding, single-use withdrawal intent, and semantic allowance compiler assertions.
